result.detail: The requirement's numeric bounds for line, toggle and branch are not in my sections, so I cannot tell whether the toggle ceiling above is a problem. If coverage.read reports toggle below a bound because of the dead-by-construction bits, I propose escalating to verification.dynamic.coverage.code.senior. The options would be: accept them as justified unreachable exclusions; ask the RTL owner to add coverage_off around unused_wdata in the design file; or set the bound on reachable or port toggle. I did not cite run-0001 as a coverage result: it is the idle testbench's simulation, not a run of this testbench.
